author: Forbes
description:
Forbes senior editor Chris Hellman sits down with Anton Anton Troynikov, CEO and co-founder of American Terawatt, to discuss the hidden energy crisis behind the AI boom. Because the legacy U.S. power grid was never designed to add a gigawatt of demand at once, everyday consumers are currently footing the bill for the massive wire and transformer upgrades required by new tech facilities.

To solve this, American Terawatt—backed by Founders Fund and Altimeter—is proposing a bold alternative: building a brand new, underground high-voltage direct current (DC) transmission network specifically for heavy industrial loads. By taking these massive data centers off the legacy grid, the startup aims to stop consumer power bills from rising while simultaneously unblocking America's energy bottleneck.

author: Forbes
description:
How do you pivot from chasing empty viral trends to building a fiercely loyal community of over 40 million followers?

Welcome to the Forbes Top Creator Show! This week, host Steven Bertoni sits down with creator and entrepreneur Rebecca Zamolo.

In this episode, Rebecca reveals her biggest career mistake: focusing entirely on viral videos and realizing her massive audience didn't actually know her. She opens up about shifting her strategy to true vulnerability, sharing her battle with a severe, life-altering illness and an isolating two-year struggle with infertility. Rebecca explains why she downsized her production crew from 20 people to just 5, leaning into the philosophy that high-retention storytelling on a $5,000 budget can successfully compete with bloated, multi-million dollar productions. title: Why Radical Vulnerability Beat Viral Fame: Rebecca Zamolo's Blueprint For True Community
